Kerala Govt Sanctions Prosecution in Cashew Import Case

The Kerala government has granted sanction to prosecute a former chairperson and managing director of the Kerala State Cashew Development Corporation (KSCDC) in connection with a cashew import scam. The High Court was informed of this decision. The case involves allegations of corruption related to cashew imports.
